_comment: User-scope MCP servers applied by `install.sh --with-integrations` via `claude mcp add-json --scope user`. No secrets here: servers that need auth log in themselves (notebooklm: `notebooklm login`). Account connectors (Slack, Atlassian, GitHub, Gmail, Calendar, Drive) come from claude.ai and are NOT declared here. See docs/decisions/0016-integrations-plugins-mcp.md.

obsidian.post: vault path comes from $OBSIDIAN_VAULT (default ~/Documents/Obsidian Vault) when install.sh runs; commit/back up the vault before heavy edits
